# Android AI — Copilot instructions

These standards apply to every Android task. Specialised skills go deeper. The router at the bottom says which one to load.

## Standards

| Area | Rule |
|---|---|
| Language | Kotlin only. No new Java. Never use `!!`. Prefer `val`, `data class`, `sealed interface`. |
| SDK | `minSdk` 26+, `targetSdk`/`compileSdk` = latest stable API |
| Architecture | MVVM + Clean Architecture: UI → Domain → Data. Domain is pure Kotlin (no `android.*`). |
| State | `ViewModel` exposes `StateFlow<UiState>`. One-shot events use `SharedFlow` (see `coroutine-flow`). |
| DI | Framework-agnostic (Hilt, Koin, Anvil, Metro, Dagger, manual). Constructor injection and interfaces. One framework per project. |
| Async | Coroutines + Flow. No RxJava, no callbacks, no `GlobalScope`. Inject dispatchers. |
| UI | Jetpack Compose. Design-system agnostic: `@Immutable` token data classes provided through `CompositionLocal`. Components never read raw colours or sizes. Material3 is optional. |
| Compose rules | Slack/`io.nlopez` compose rules: `modifier: Modifier = Modifier` on every emitter, state hoisting, no ViewModel parameters, stable params, `collectAsStateWithLifecycle()` |
| Testing | JUnit Jupiter (5/6) + Turbine + MockK + `kotlinx-coroutines-test` + Compose UI test + screenshot tests (Roborazzi — see `write-tests`). Fakes over mocks for repositories. |
| Lint | ktlint + Detekt + compose rules + Android Lint. Zero warnings, and baselines only for legacy code. |
| Build | Kotlin DSL, `libs.versions.toml`, convention plugins in `build-logic/`, configuration cache on, AGP 9 built-in Kotlin |
| CI | `gradle/actions/setup-gradle`, actions pinned to full SHA, configuration-cache encryption key as a secret |
| Security | No secrets in code, Gradle files or `BuildConfig`. Network security config. R8 on for release. |

## Ground truth before answering

1. Read the project: `gradle/libs.versions.toml`, `settings.gradle.kts`, the module's `build.gradle.kts`. `android describe` (Android CLI) gives a compact map when available.
2. For API questions, check official docs. Use the Google Developer Knowledge MCP `search_documents` tool if connected (see [`google-integrations`](.agents/skills/google-integrations/SKILL.md)).
3. Match the surrounding code's DI framework, navigation library and design system. Never introduce a second one.
